title: Vibe Studio
description: Vibe code with several AI agents at once: your Claude Code and Codex chats side by side, each with its own message box, plus cats, a shelf and a magic wand.

title: Z-Accept
description: Auto-confirm intermediate AI tool popups (git, cd, ls, npm) while keeping full code diff review manual.

title: nftables Syntax Highlighting (Ameon)
description: Syntax highlighting for nftables configuration files

title: Xcode Project Viewer (pbxproj)
description: Xcode project viewer for VS Code: open project.pbxproj as targets, build phases, files and groups, build settings with inherited values and Swift packages, instead of thousands of lines of ids. Broken references flagged. Read-only, offline, works on Linux and Windows without Xcode.

title: Plist Viewer & Editor (Binary)
description: Plist editor and viewer for binary, XML and OpenStep plists: an Xcode-style tree to add, delete, reorder and retype keys, saved in the format the file came in. Reads Info.plist, entitlements and provisioning profiles. Offline, no plutil needed.

title: Minidump Viewer & Crash Dump
description: Minidump viewer for Windows, Linux and macOS crash dumps (.dmp, .mdmp): the exception, the crashing thread's stack, modules with versions, threads with registers and raw stack memory. Nothing to install, nothing uploaded.

title: Language Server for Tilt by Bitno
description: A lightweight Tiltfile language server for VS Code: completion, hover, signature help, symbols and diagnostics for Tilt's Starlark API

title: Markdown Unread Changes
description: Markdown ファイルの、前回読んだときからの変更箇所を、VS Code 標準の Markdown プレビューで色付けします。拡張機能自体はインターネットに接続しません。

title: htmlhost: Deploy HTML Sites
description: Put an HTML site online from the folder you have open: deploy, save drafts, pull changes back and open the live site.
